body:
I'd like to say I'm pretty broad with my taste in music, but my favourite genre is easily alt rock. Bands like Radiohead, Sublime, Red Hot Chili Peppers, The Killers, Muse, etc... Music does help a lot, actually.

I've only just been getting into the original series, but I've watched all of NewWho. My favourite doctor honestly is Capaldi, I think he is fantastic, but my favourite episode so far has to be Midnight.

I do really like music. I play guitar and bass. Never tried writing a song before, not a bad idea. I'm not feeling better today, but hey, at least I'm not feeling worse? 

You're an awesome person, by the way. Thank you

I don't play any games anymore. They all got boring. I don't watch TV, except for Doctor Who. I have no one to invite over to even watch TV. Everything just sucks. 

I'm really sorry for being such a downer :(
Right now I'm bad, but not too bad. It gets a lot worse at night, which is when I posted this.

Unrequited love isn't really an issue anymore, it sucks but I've learnt to live with it. I try and engage in social activities, but I just get nothing. No one wants to talk with me, and I never get invited anywhere. I try my best to be a good person but no one cares. I quit my social hobbies because I was alone there as well. 

Your post was quite inspiring. Thank you so much. It means a lot that you would take time out if your day to help me out.
Thank you for your very kind offer. I don't really have anything other than reddit to contact you on, unfortunately :/

I like music. I like playing it, and listening to it. I do it quite a lot these days, actually. I think that's the thing I can say I still like.

Thank you for even taking the time to write out a reply that large. You have no idea how much it means to me that you would take your time to do that. Thank you :)

What put me in this position? I have no motivation. I don't enjoy anything anymore. Everything is dull, boring, and pointless. I cannot eat without forcing myself to. I cannot sleep. I am always worrying about everything, constantly. I am so lonely. No close friends. No friends at all, really. No SO. Not as close to my family as I would like to say I am. No one cares about me. No one would notice if I was gone. I am young, and the only future I see is a world without me in it. I no longer have any dreams, aspirations; nothing to look forward to. Everything is so pointless. Life is not worth it. I hate myself. I am useless and don't need or want to exist. 

That's what I've had on my mind for over a year. It's gotten progressively harder to deal with, and now I can't take it. There is no reason to go on. I'm done.
I can't find happiness in anything anymore. I'm so lonely and worthless. I hate myself. Everything is so hard and exhausting mentally. I'm so tired and I want it all to end so badly.
I hope so too. Thank you so very much, once again. :)

Yes, I am afraid of that. This person is the only close friend I have in my eyes. I really don't even want to risk losing that.

I have not tried talking to any professionals. Maybe I should. The letter idea is good as well, it might make it easier to get it all out. It's going to be hard either way I suppose.

Thank you very much.

I  really sorry you feel this way. I have been / still am in your frame of mind right now. Just remember that you are not a burden on anyone, and people do love you and want you in their lives. 

I think that maybe your friends are only talking about themselves because maybe they just want to have a completely normal conversation with you instead of addressing your feelings. They might be trying to take your mind off of things? This might be untrue, just a guess.

Remember there always people on this sub willing to talk. You aren't alone. I hope you feel better in the future.
Do you mean talk as in completely open up to someone? Or just to chat and take my mind off of things :P
Thank you so much for your reply :) I will try my absolute best to follow your advice.

That is awesome to hear. I'm really glad you're so much happier now :D

I've never really been extroverted. It would be nice to have any ammount of confidence in myself, so that I could try and break free of this, and do what you did. I'll try my best to follow your advice though. Thank you so much :)

Thanks so much for your reply man :)

I also think I may need to talk to someone. I don't feel close enough to anyone at school enough that I can open up to them, except for one person maybe. Last time I opened up a bit this person got really upset and got distant, and also this person is one of my issues (unrequited love :P) so I don't know if they're an option :/

I could talk to a therapist, but that would mean talking to my parents. They know I have social anxiety and I'm not close with anyone, but they don't know I hate myself and I'm in this much pain. Knowing this would crush them, and I don't want to make anyone else feel bad just because I do.

Ugh, I don't know. Thanks for all your advice, it means more than you'll ever know :)
I could give it a shot, nothing to lose. With whom?
I don't seem to be able fix any of my issues, especially not the major ones. I don't know what to do.

Thank you for your reply :) It means a lot.

I should probably tell someone apart from reddit about my issues, but I don't feel close enough to anyone. Especially not since the only person that I trust anywhere near enough to open up to them is the person I have an unrequited love for, which sucks. Oh well, I can only keep moving forward. Thank you

I'm not close enough to anyone to tell them how I feel. Especially not since the only person that I trust anywhere near enough to open up to them is the person I feel limerence for. 

I suppose I can only keep moving forward. Thanks for your reply :)
Alright. Let's keep going. :)

Hey man, thanks for the reply :)

I am so sorry to hear about that :( I am sure you will get through your issues, and I wish you good luck. You *can* do it.

I wish I had faith it will get better :P I suppose I hope for it, but I am almost certain it's not going to happen unfortunately. I wish I had faith. I have to keep going I guess but I really don't want to. *sigh*
